items.title: Board results 2025–26: Anushka Thakur and Dishant Ravi lead the way
items.summary: Anushka Thakur tops ICSE with 96.6% and Dishant Ravi tops ISC with 95%, as nineteen students are honoured at a school felicitation.
body: Our Class X and Class XII students have once again made the school proud. In the ICSE examination, Anushka Thakur leads with 96.6%, followed by Subhvan Singh (95.4%) and Parv Bansal (94%). In the ISC examination, Dishant Ravi tops with 95%, followed by Izma Anjum (94.75%) and Om Agarwal (93.25%).
The toppers were garlanded and honoured with their families at a felicitation in the school hall. Congratulations to every student, and thank you to the teachers and parents who stood behind them.

image.alt: Board toppers in garlands and sashes in the school hall

items.title: Independence Day 2025: a celebration of India’s many colours
items.summary: The band led the march-past, guests were honoured, and students brought India’s diversity to the stage in song and dance.
body: The 79th Independence Day began with the school band in full ceremonial dress, a march-past across the green and a guard of honour for our guests.

On the Divine Mercy Rangmanch stage, students presented patriotic songs, a skit, folk and classical dances and a tableau celebrating the many cultures of India. Sisters and guests honoured invited dignitaries with mementos and certificates.

image.alt: The school band in red and white uniforms marching with trumpets
